subject: Request: CXO signoff for one-off sandbox credit & extended POC
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-05 09:15 -0700
Subject: EvokeBio - urgent ask: extended sandbox + extra credits

Olga / Marissa,

Quick summary: EvokeBio (contacts Leah Barnes / Priya Sinha) are in an advanced technical evaluation. They are hitting the free sandbox limits today — their models need a larger token budget to properly validate streaming latency and workload patterns. Procurement has signaled they won't be able to approve a purchase order until their security team completes a short review, which will take ~3-4 weeks.

Why this matters: EvokeBio is a likely strategic health-tech customer (pilot -> paid in 75% of similar cases this quarter). If we pause now they will move to a competitor for inference testing. We typically don't extend beyond the PLG sandbox window or the standard free-credit threshold, but this is a time-sensitive case.

What I'm asking: can we get CXO signoff for a one-off sandbox credit uplift of 200k tokens and a 30-day POC extension beyond the standard 14-day window? I'll require legal to sign a pilot addendum and procurement will sign receipt of credits.

Attached: procurement request PDF and a draft pilot addendum (template) — legal will need to scope.

Next steps I propose:
- If exec approves, I will send the pilot addendum to EvokeBio (DocuSign).
- Coordinate with infra to tag free credits and set an expiration.
- Track in HubSpot (DEAL-12984).

Thanks,
Jordan

--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-05 11:20 -07:00
Subject: Re: EvokeBio - urgent ask: extended sandbox + extra credits

Confirming commercial intent: EvokeBio has two internal teams (ML infra + Clinical Apps) prepared to sign a purchase order once security clears. They've verbally committed to a 12-month initial contract expected to start within 60 days after the POC.

HubSpot notes: DEAL-12984 — deal stage: procurement review. ARR estimate: $180k first year (conservative). They are evaluating latency under production-like streaming conditions which the current sandbox token cap prevents.

Precedent: we approved a 150k uplift for a healthcare pilot in Q2 when legal required an addendum; we limited scope to generation tokens only and required PO acceptance within 45 days.

Will draft a one-paragraph commercial covenant for the addendum (commit to commercial review and PO timeline).

—Marissa
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-06 09:14 -07:00
Subject: Re: EvokeBio - urgent ask: extended sandbox + extra credits

Thanks for the clear context. I reviewed the ask and the commercial signal. I approve a one-off concession with the following conditions: 

1) Credit uplift: approve 150,000 free generation tokens (not embeddings) — reduced from the requested 200k to limit downside.
2) Extension: approve a 21-day POC extension beyond the standard PLG window (total pilot duration documented in addendum).
3) Paperwork: legal-approved pilot addendum signed by EvokeBio and countersigned by Redwood prior to credits being issued; pilot must include the commercial covenant Marissa will draft.
4) Time-to-convert incentive: if EvokeBio signs a qualifying annual contract within 60 days of the pilot close, Redwood will additionally offer a one-time 20% first-year usage-credit discount (documented in SOW).
5) Tracking: Jordan to update HubSpot (DEAL-12984) and ops to flag the account so credits are tracked separately and expire automatically after the pilot.

Rationale: strong product fit and a clear procurement timeline. Reducing tokens and shortening the extension balances risk while keeping momentum.

Olga — please coordinate with Legal and Finance to ensure the addendum includes the limits above and a PO acceptance clause. Once legal confirms, Jordan can proceed to send the addendum and we'll issue the credits programmatically upon DocuSign completion.

Aditya
Co-founder & COO
Redwood Inference

- Pilot extension: 21 additional days beyond the current PLG window.
- Conditions: pilot addendum (DocuSign) must be signed by EvokeBio and countersigned by Redwood before credits are issued. The addendum will also include a PO-acceptance clause and a conversion incentive (20% usage credit on first-year spend if contract signed within 60 days of pilot close).

1) Please review and sign the pilot addendum here: https://app.docusign.com/sandbox/addendum/EVK-PA-12984

Internal: Olga / Marissa / Aditya — once the addendum is signed, please notify Ops to issue the credits and tag the account. Jordan will update HubSpot (DEAL-12984) with the signed addendum and credit issuance.

Thanks everyone — Jordan will handle the DocuSign flow and follow up with Ops.
